name: Weight
desc: Minimalist groovy gqom: sparse broken-triplet drums and a heavy sub under an oil-black ferrofluid field spiking in lava tones. Dark, spacious, hypnotic — the groove is in what is left out. Sits before an upbeat close and makes the lift land harder.
notes: GENE LOVED THIS ONE (2026-07-16) — described it as 'kind of minimalist sounding groovy', the minimalist set before the upbeat close. Positive taste signal: sparse dark groove, space over density. Followed well by kit.trance_anthem x arc.build_drop (A major lift). arc.ghost_intro opens at intensity 0.15 so it enters almost subliminally — that quiet entrance is part of the appeal, do not swap it for a busier arc. ferrofluid style must stay off 'ink'/'chrome' (monochrome/high-contrast -> strobe risk); 'lava' is the safe colorful pick.
